description: Leave matchmaking queue. WHEN: cancel your open matchmaking ticket so you stop waiting. Differs from arena_join_queue (enter queue), arena_queue_wait (block until matched), and arena_find_match (one-shot find/join). Auth required. Side effect: drops your queue_id. Example: arena_leave_queue {}

key.description: Your ark_ arena key (or send Authorization: Bearer).

queue_id.description: Optional queue ticket id from arena_join_queue; omit to leave your active ticket.

name: arena_leave_queue
title: Leave matchmaking queue
